result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with well-maintained sidewalks and modern curb ramps equipped with tactile warning surfaces. However, the crossing lacks high-visibility markings, and parked vehicles along the curb create significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left curb line leading up to the foreground intersection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Pedestrian Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at an intersection with curb ramps may lead to driver confusion and failure to yield.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices. The environment is characterized by poor pavement quality and sight line obstructions from parked vehicles and corner vegetation.
